author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

This is the fourth collection in the “One Fruit for a Table” series, continuing the exploration of Yunnan’s seasonal fruits and the many flavors they bring to the table. Some are sweet and juicy, some are crisp and refreshing, while others offer a bright tartness or a rich, lingering fragrance. Each one carries the character of the land and the rhythm of the season.

From branch to cutting board, and from orchard to family table, each fruit is transformed into drinks, desserts, savory dishes, and comforting home-cooked meals. Between sweetness, tartness, smoke, and spice lies the generosity of the land, along with the simple warmth of cooking, sharing, and gathering together.
